description: Marlow, the docklands fixer (M6 spec claim 14): stands on the street south of the starter plot and gives the Cold Storage contract.
name: Marlow

lines.briefing: Cold Storage, on the docklands. Their records sit on a terminal in the server room, upstairs. Get them out, bring them to me. Front door takes a staff keycard; there's one in a crate in their yard. Or go round the side, or under. Quieter is worth more.
lines.turn_in: That's the drive. Pleasure doing business.
lines.refusal: Not yet. Bring me the records from Cold Storage, and come and see me in person.
